inputs.question: Total quantity of 'Dairy Products' sold during 'Winter Classics 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar. Return an integer.
Total quantity of 'Dairy Products' sold during 'Winter Classics 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar. Return an integer.

outputs.constraints:
DATE WINDOW: date(OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-12-01' AND '2017-12-31' (inclusive; from marketing_calendar::chunk2)
  COLUMN: OrderDate is a column of Orders only
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.

inputs.question: Total quantity of 'Dairy Products' sold during 'Winter Classics 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar. Return an integer.

outputs.sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-12-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND c.CategoryName='Dairy Products'
